BiblicalUsage: Choriy is a Horite, one of the aboriginal people of Seir, and the histories trace them from the kings to the genealogies. The kings smite the Horites in Mount Seir, the law says the Horites dwelt there before Esau's sons dispossessed them, and the genealogy of Seir the Horite is kept among the sons of Esau.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Horites are the people who were there before, and their record shows that God keeps the history of the displaced as well as the conquerors. I hold that no people is forgotten in His book, even the ones who lose the land.
